summary: TIME precision follows Spark 4.3.0 (the default profile): a TIME literal keeps up to 9 fractional digits and is typed time(9), and extract(SECOND FROM <time(p)>) is decimal(p+2,p); Spark 4.2.0, which this golden records, cuts the literal to 6 digits (time(6)) and types the second as decimal(8,6). The 4.3.0 golden profile expects the 4.3 results.
